H3605: properly, the whole; hence, all, any or every (in the singular only, but often in a plural sense)
H6256: time, especially (adverb with preposition) now, when, etc.
H2656: pleasure; hence (abstractly) desire; concretely, a valuable thing; hence (by extension) a matter (as something in mind)
H8478: the bottom (as depressed); only adverbially, below (often with prepositional prefix underneath), in lieu of, etc.
H8064: the sky (as aloft; the dual perhaps alluding to the visible arch in which the clouds move, as well as to the higher ether where the celestial bodies revolve)
H3205: to bear young; causatively, to beget; medically, to act as midwife; specifically, to show lineage
H4191: to die (literally or figuratively); causatively, to kill
H5193: properly, to strike in, i.e. fix; specifically, to plant (literally or figuratively)
H6131: to pluck up (especially by the roots); specifically, to hamstring; figuratively, to exterminate
H7495: properly, to mend (by stitching), i.e. (figuratively) to cure
H6555: to break out (in many applications, direct and indirect, literal and figurative)
H7832: to laugh (in pleasure or detraction); by implication, to play
H5594: properly, to tear the hair and beat the breasts (as Orientals do in grief); generally to lament; by implication, to wail
H7540: properly, to stamp, i.e. to spring about (wildly or for joy)
H7993: to throw out, down or away (literally or figuratively)
H2263: to clasp (the hands or in embrace)
H7368: to widen (in any direction), i.e. (intransitively) recede or (transitively) remove (literally or figuratively, of place or relation)
H1245: to search out (by any method, specifically in worship or prayer); by implication, to strive after
H6: properly, to wander away, i.e. lose oneself; by implication to perish (causative, destroy)
H8104: properly, to hedge about (as with thorns), i.e. guard; generally, to protect, attend to, etc.
H7167: to rend, literally or figuratively (revile, paint the eyes, as if enlarging them)
H1696: perhaps properly, to arrange; but used figuratively (of words), to speak; rarely (in a destructive sense) to subdue
H157: to have affection for (sexually or otherwise)
H4421: a battle (i.e. the engagement); generally, war (i.e. warfare)
H7965: safe, i.e. (figuratively) well, happy, friendly; also (abstractly) welfare, i.e. health, prosperity, peace
H4100: properly, interrogative what? (including how? why? when?); but also exclamation, what! (including how!), or indefinitely what (including whatever, and even relatively, that which); often used with prefixes in various adverbial or conjunctive senses
H6213: to do or make, in the broadest sense and widest application
H834: who, which, what, that; also (as an adverb and a conjunction) when, where, how, because, in order that, etc.
H1931: he (she or it); only expressed when emphatic or without a verb; also (intensively) self, or (especially with the article) the same; sometimes (as demonstrative) this or that; occasionally (instead of copula) as or are
H6001: toiling; concretely, a laborer; figuratively, sorrowful
H7200: to see, literally or figuratively (in numerous applications, direct and implied, transitive, intransitive and causative)
H853: properly, self (but generally used to point out more definitely the object of a verb or preposition, even or namely)
H6045: ado, i.e. (generally) employment or (specifically) an affair
H5414: to give, used with greatest latitude of application (put, make, etc.)
H430: gods in the ordinary sense; but specifically used (in the plural thus, especially with the article) of the supreme God; occasionally applied by way of deference to magistrates; and sometimes as a superlative
H1121: a son (as a builder of the family name), in the widest sense (of literal and figurative relationship, including grandson, subject, nation, quality or condition, etc., (like father or brother), etc.)
H120: ruddy i.e. a human being (an individual or the species, mankind, etc.)
H6031: to depress literally or figuratively, transitive or intransitive (in various applications, as follows)
H1571: properly, assemblage; used only adverbially also, even, yea, though; often repeated as correl. both...and
H5769: properly, concealed, i.e. the vanishing point; generally, time out of mind (past or future), i.e. (practically) eternity; frequentatively, adverbial (especially with prepositional prefix) always
H3820: the heart; also used (figuratively) very widely for the feelings, the will and even the intellect; likewise for the centre of anything
H1097: properly, failure, i.e. nothing or destruction; usually (with preposition) without, not yet, because not, as long as, etc.
H3808: not (the simple or abs. negation); by implication, no; often used with other particles
H4672: properly, to come forth to, i.e. appear or exist; transitively, to attain, i.e. find or acquire; figuratively, to occur, meet or be present
H4639: an action (good or bad); generally, a transaction; abstractly, activity; by implication, a product (specifically, a poem) or (generally) property
H7218: the head (as most easily shaken), whether literal or figurative (in many applications, of place, time, rank, itc.)
H5704: as far (or long, or much) as, whether of space (even unto) or time (during, while, until) or degree (equally with)
H3045: to know (properly, to ascertain by seeing); used in a great variety of senses, figuratively, literally, euphemistically and inferentially (including observation, care, recognition; and causatively, instruction, designation, punishment, etc.)
H3588: (by implication) very widely used as a relative conjunction or adverb (as below); often largely modified by other particles annexed
H369: a non-entity; generally used as a negative particle
H2896: good (as an adjective) in the widest sense; used likewise as a noun, both in the masculine and the feminine, the singular and the plural (good, a good or good thing, a good man or woman; the good, goods or good things, good men or women), also as an adverb (well)
H518: used very widely as demonstrative, lo!; interrogative, whether?; or conditional, if, although; also Oh that!, when; hence, as a negative, not
H8055: probably to brighten up, i.e. (figuratively) be (causatively, make) blithe or gleesome
H2416: alive; hence, raw (flesh); fresh (plant, water, year), strong; also (as noun, especially in the feminine singular and masculine plural) life (or living thing), whether literally or figuratively
H5999: toil, i.e. wearing effort; hence, worry, wheth. of body or mind
H1961: to exist, i.e. be or become, come to pass (always emphatic, and not a mere copula or auxiliary)
H5921: above, over, upon, or against (yet always in this last relation with a downward aspect) in a great variety of applications
H3254: to add or augment (often adverbial, to continue to do a thing)
H4480: properly, a part of; hence (prepositionally), from or out of in many senses
H1639: to scrape off; by implication, to shave, remove, lessen, withhold
H3372: to fear; morally, to revere; caus. to frighten
H6440: the face (as the part that turns); used in a great variety of applications (literally and figuratively); also (with prepositional prefix) as a preposition (before, etc.)
H3528: properly, extent of time, i.e. a great while; hence, long ago, formerly, hitherto
H7291: to run after (usually with hostile intent; figuratively (of time) gone by)
H5750: properly, iteration or continuance; used only adverbially (with or without preposition), again, repeatedly, still, more
H8121: the sun; by implication, the east; figuratively, a ray, i.e. (architectural) a notched battlement
H4725: properly, a standing, i.e. a spot; but used widely of a locality (general or specific); also (figuratively) of a condition (of body or mind)
H4941: properly, a verdict (favorable or unfavorable) pronounced judicially, especially a sentence or formal decree (human or (participant's) divine law, individual or collective), including the act, the place, the suit, the crime, and the penalty; abstractly, justice, including a participant's right or privilege (statutory or customary), or even a style
H8033: there (transferring to time) then; often thither, or thence
H6664: the right (natural, moral or legal); also (abstractly) equity or (figuratively) prosperity
H7563: morally wrong; concretely, an (actively) bad person
H8199: to judge, i.e. pronounce sentence (for or against); by implication, to vindicate or punish; by extenssion, to govern; passively, to litigate (literally or figuratively)
H929: properly, a dumb beast; especially any large quadruped or animal (often collective)
H4745: something met with, i.e. an accident or fortune
H259: properly, united, i.e. one; or (as an ordinal) first
H4194: death (natural or violent); concretely, the dead, their place or state (hades); figuratively, pestilence, ruin
H2088: the masculine demonstrative pronoun, this or that
H3651: properly, set upright; hence (figuratively as adjective) just; but usually (as adverb or conjunction) rightly or so (in various applications to manner, time and relation; often with other particles)
H7307: wind; by resemblance breath, i.e. a sensible (or even violent) exhalation; figuratively, life, anger, unsubstantiality; by extension, a region of the sky; by resemblance spirit, but only of a rational being (including its expression and functions)
H1892: emptiness or vanity; figuratively, something transitory and unsatisfactory; often used as an adverb
H1980: to walk (in a great variety of applications, literally and figuratively)
H413: near, with or among; often in general, to
H6083: dust (as powdered or gray); hence, clay, earth, mud
H7725: to turn back (hence, away) transitively or intransitively, literally or figuratively (not necessarily with the idea of return to the starting point); generally to retreat; often adverbial, again
H4310: who? (occasionally, by a peculiar idiom, of things); also (indefinitely) whoever; often used in oblique construction with prefix or suffix
H5927: to ascend, intransitively (be high) or actively (mount); used in a great variety of senses, primary and secondary, literal and figurative
H4605: properly, the upper part, used only adverbially with prefix upward, above, overhead, from the top, etc.
H3381: to descend (literally, to go downwards; or conventionally to a lower region, as the shore, a boundary, the enemy, etc.; or figuratively, to fall); causatively, to bring down (in all the above applications)
H4295: downward, below or beneath; often adverbially with or without prefixes
H776: the earth (at large, or partitively a land)
H2506: properly, smoothness (of the tongue); also an allotment
H935: to go or come (in a wide variety of applications)
H310: properly, the hind part; generally used as an adverb or conjunction, after (in various senses)
